axMail.legalBody: Korean Network Act Art. 50(1): a first sales email to a company counts as advertising. Drafts are allowed only with a recorded basis — a business card received in person, a request from the recipient, or an existing customer within 6 months of a transaction (existing-customer mail keeps "(광고)" in the subject). Drafts include the sender and opt-out notice required by Art. 50(4). Sending is your call.

siteAudit.metaDescription: Inspect the evidence that shows whether a site is technically accessible and understandable to AI search engines.
siteAudit.title: Can AI read your website?
siteAudit.description: Inspect real site responses from robots.txt to structured data. This audit covers technical readiness; whether AI actually mentions your brand is measured separately.
siteAudit.formHint: Checks public responses and up to 10 pages, then measures Google mobile performance. A complete audit can take about a minute.

non_2xx.title: Non-successful page response
non_2xx.advice: Fix errors and redirects so important URLs return HTTP 2xx.

noindex.title: Page blocked from indexing
noindex.advice: Remove noindex from meta robots or X-Robots-Tag when the page should be public.

canonical_missing.title: Canonical missing
canonical_missing.advice: Declare the preferred URL on each page to avoid duplicate URL ambiguity.

canonical_mismatch.title: Canonical mismatch
canonical_mismatch.advice: Verify that the page does not unintentionally declare another URL as canonical.

schema_invalid.title: Invalid JSON-LD
schema_invalid.advice: Correct the JSON syntax and verify it again with Rich Results Test.

schema_required_missing.title: Structured-data fields missing
schema_required_missing.advice: Add required properties that match the content visitors can actually see.

title_missing.title: Page title missing
title_missing.advice: Write a unique title that clearly describes the page topic and brand.

h1_missing.title: H1 missing
h1_missing.advice: Add a primary H1 that states the page topic in one clear sentence.

broken_internal_link.title: Broken internal link
broken_internal_link.advice: Replace internal URLs that return errors or redirect them to the correct live page.

thin_article_content.title: Thin evidence in an article
thin_article_content.advice: Add a direct answer, examples, data, and enough detail to substantively cover the topic.

citation_sources_missing.title: External evidence links missing
citation_sources_missing.advice: Link directly to primary statistics, research, and official sources that support the article.

author_signal_missing.title: Author or publication signals missing
author_signal_missing.advice: Expose the author name and profile plus publication and modification dates to readers and machines.

slow_ttfb.title: Slow first response
slow_ttfb.advice: Review caching, CDN, and server queries to bring TTFB below 800ms.

slow_response.title: Slow HTML response
slow_response.advice: Optimize server rendering and response size to bring the complete response below 2.5 seconds.

siteAudit.noScoreTitle: Readiness and actual AI visibility are different metrics
siteAudit.noScoreBody: This view does not fabricate a composite score. llms.txt is shown as information because it is not a universal standard. Measure ChatGPT and Perplexity answers separately under Brand & measurement.
siteAudit.lockedDescription: Inspect whether AI search bots can access your site and whether machines can understand its content, backed by real response evidence.
lockedBullets: Check GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot access
Inspect title, description, H1, canonical and JSON-LD structure
Show observed evidence and fixes instead of a synthetic percentage

https.title: HTTPS connection
https.advice: Serve every public page over HTTPS and redirect HTTP requests to the matching secure URL.

status.title: Homepage response
status.advice: The primary URL should return HTTP 2xx without requiring a login or showing an error page.

robots.title: robots.txt
robots.advice: Return a valid robots.txt and make sure important public content is not blocked accidentally.

aiBots.title: Major AI bot access
aiBots.advice: Choose access rules for each AI bot deliberately. Avoid blocking core pages when AI search visibility is the goal.

sitemap.title: XML sitemap
sitemap.advice: Publish a sitemap.xml with current canonical URLs and declare its location in robots.txt.

title.title: Page title
title.advice: Use a unique title that clearly describes the page topic and brand.

description.title: Meta description
description.advice: Write a concise, specific description of who the page helps and what it answers.

h1.title: Primary H1
h1.advice: Use one clear H1 that states the primary topic of the page.

canonical.title: Canonical URL
canonical.advice: When duplicate URLs exist, declare a canonical link to the preferred address.

jsonLd.title: JSON-LD structured data
jsonLd.advice: Add valid Organization, Product, Article or other relevant schemas that match visible page content.

language.title: Document language
language.advice: Declare the page's primary language with a lang attribute on the html element. For example, lang="en".

viewport.title: Mobile viewport
viewport.advice: Provide a viewport meta tag for mobile-width screens and do not restrict zoom.

openGraph.title: Share preview metadata
openGraph.advice: Provide og:title, og:description and og:image so share previews stay consistent.

serverContent.title: Content in server HTML
serverContent.advice: Include essential copy in the server response instead of revealing it only after JavaScript runs.

semanticHtml.title: Semantic HTML structure
semanticHtml.advice: Separate primary content and navigation with meaningful elements such as main, article and headings.

trustLinks.title: Company and policy information
trustLinks.advice: Link to company details, contact information, privacy policy and terms so the operator is verifiable.

freshness.title: Modification date signal
freshness.advice: For time-sensitive content, provide a visible date plus machine-readable datetime or metadata.

llmsTxt.title: llms.txt information
llmsTxt.advice: You may publish this guide file, but it does not guarantee AI visibility and is excluded from evaluation totals.

competitorBoard.lede: Which brands AI brings up, and in what order, when it answers with “recommendations” or “rankings”.
competitorBoard.glossary: The number on the left ranks brands by “how often they appeared” (mention rate). The “avg” on the right is the average position when they did appear, so the two measure different things. A brand that appears rarely but is always first can have a better average than one that appears often but moves up and down.

actionEvidence.disclaimer: Effort, re-measure timing and revisit conditions are Findable's internal working estimates and don't prove an effect.
actionEvidence.gradeStrongMeaning: A prerequisite confirmed by official documentation.
actionEvidence.gradeMediumMeaning: Backed by large observational studies or official documentation. Most of it is correlation, so the effect isn't guaranteed.
actionEvidence.gradeWeakMeaning: Only a few experiments, or not enough replication.
actionEvidence.gradeNoneMeaning: No confirmed effect, or a risk of backfiring or breaking platform rules.

integrations.noCompositeTitle: We don't hide measurements behind a composite score
integrations.noCompositeBody: Search Console, GA4, site readiness and AI answer visibility are separate metrics with different sources and dates. We show each source and its last sync time.
integrations.scopeBody: Today we connect Google Search Console and GA4 directly and read-only, import Naver performance by CSV, and keep IndexNow as a separate indexing notice. Bing Webmaster Tools is the next candidate for a direct connection. We never show zero when there's no customer data, and we add new integrations only after checking their permission scope and data retention.

salesDiscover.title: Find companies
salesDiscover.description: Filter companies loaded from public sources, check each fact's source on the company card, then move on to measurement, report and draft. This screen cannot send mail.
salesDiscover.disabledBody: It opens only when the SALES_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=true environment variable is set (off by default).
salesDiscover.dbNotReadyBody: The sales discovery tables (migration 20261007_sales_discovery) are not in this database yet. Apply it and reopen.
salesDiscover.segmentFilterHelp: Prefilled with the chips you picked. Supports industries, tags (tagsAll/tagsAny/excludeTags), regions, sizes, founding year, employee growth and website/e-mail presence.
salesDiscover.segmentInvalidJson: The filter JSON is not valid.
salesDiscover.segmentInvalid: This segment's saved filter could not be read, so only the chips are applied.
salesDiscover.addedCount: Added {count} companies to the sales list (existing ones unchanged).
salesDiscover.emptyNoData: No companies loaded yet. Use "Load data" to fetch one page per API source, or load the file sources.
salesDiscover.measureRegistered: Registered as a brand and started measurement (3–5 min).
salesDiscover.cardEmpty: Pick a company in the table.
salesDiscover.matchNameOnly: Matched by name and region only — may be a different company with the same name.

salesDiscover.contactsHelp: Only inquiry/partnership addresses published on the company's own site. One Gmail draft is created per checked address.

contactStatus.none: Read the site but found no public e-mail.

salesDiscover.ingestHelp: Fetches one page from each API source (FSC, NPS, MFDS, FTC, DART listed) and loads it. File sources (venture, Inno-Biz, Main-Biz lists) remain a manual download step.
